name: ConnectMachine
description:
ConnectMachine is a digital business-card and contact platform. This connector lets Claude work with your ConnectMachine network in natural language.

Contacts: create, find, update, and delete contacts; smart search across name, company, job title, email, phone, notes, location, and the event where you met. When two contacts share a name, the connector reports the ambiguity and asks which one you mean instead of guessing.

Events: track which event you met a contact at, and organize contacts into networks (labels).

Digital cards: create and edit your business cards, including websites and social links, or extract contact data from a card photo.

Housekeeping: detect and merge duplicate contacts, see where your contacts came from, and bulk-import leads.

You sign in with your existing ConnectMachine account. Data stays in ConnectMachine; the connector only returns what is needed to answer each request. Included with ConnectMachine accounts; a few advanced actions (CSV export, industry and location filters) follow the same Premium rules as the app and reply with a clear upgrade message on free accounts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ConnectMachine to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ConnectMachine to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.connectmachine.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ConnectMachine MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ConnectMachine lists 40 MCP tools, including abort_import, add_events_to_contact, assign_contacts_to_network, create_card, create_contact, create_import_session, create_network, delete_card, delete_contacts, delete_network, export_contacts_csv, and find_contact.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ConnectMachine?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ConnectMachine in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
ConnectMachine requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ConnectMachine is developed by ConnectMachine. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
